scope: Text-only v4 evidence across four vocabulary profiles. Original is the exact Nemotron baseline; compact subsets have explicit script and existing-tag scopes. No profile imports extra rare-Latin or Unicode case/decomposition inventories. FLEURS sampling is unchanged from the pinned earlier selection. Raw and publisher-normalized forms share records; original Indic dev/reserve is previously evaluated data; synthetic concatenations are not natural code-switch evidence. No speech, dialect, arbitrary-Unicode, donor-pretraining independence or Norwegian Nynorsk certification.
